The hand controls are implement's one-shot `gate.py control` run against entry 1, fired as itself. There are four `[[control]]`s, `id` `c00` · `c01` · `c10` · `c11`. Each has one `[[control.edit]]` in `apps/browser/src/capture.rs` with `old = '''    (render_width, render_height) }'''` (it stands once, at capture.rs:99-100: the tuple and the function's closing brace) and `new` the same with `(0, 0)` · `(0, 1)` · `(1, 0)` · `(1, 1)`. Each control's `guard` is «render_scene's real returned size». Its `case` is `["render_scene_returns_the_viewport_size", "render_scene_returns_the_physical_size_at_a_hidpi_scale"]`, the libtest names' last segment. libtest runs every filtered test with no fail-fast, so both cases are reached. The kill is the default 1 800 s, since entry 1 declares `timeout = 1800`, sized to a cold per-package build of the browser. A `timeout` reading is not read as the guard held.
